items.title: *** Apply AI Summit ***
items.description: *** Apply AI Summit *** Secretary General Leonardo Cervera-Navas took part in the panel “The AI Act as a Facilitator for EU Innovation” at the European Commission's Apply AI Summit, which marked one year of the Apply AI Strategy. 🔦 Here are the main highlights 1️⃣ Protection and innovation He recalled that, like GDPR and EUDPR before it, the AI Act pursues both objectives, and that its Chapter VI provides concrete tools such as regulatory sandboxes and real-world testing. He presented the EDPS pilot sandbox with the Commission’s Directorate-General for Human Resources and Security, which tested an AI system supporting job matching in EU selection procedures. “Strong protection and innovation can go hand in hand.” Leonardo Cervera-Navas said. 2️⃣ From regulation to practice He identified four challenges for supervisory authorities: institutional and technical capacity, coordination between authorities, balancing innovation and oversight, and attracting providers to participate. “Participation is voluntary and providers may be reluctant to invest time and resources in a sandbox if the associated burden outweighs the potential benefits.” Leonardo Cervera-Navas noted. 3️⃣ One priority

items.title: *** Immaculate Kassait receives the 6th Giovanni Buttarelli Award ***
items.description: *** Immaculate Kassait receives the 6th Giovanni Buttarelli Award *** Immaculate Kassait, SC, MBS, Kenya’s first Data Protection Commissioner, has been awarded the Giovanni Buttarelli Award for her leadership and dedication to privacy and data protection in her home country, Kenya. Under her leadership, Kenya’s Office of the Data Protection Commissioner won four awards at the 2025 Global Privacy and Data Protection Awards. Her career is already recognised at home, and this award extends that recognition to the international stage. The EDPS Secretary General Leonardo Cervera-Navas presented the award at the 48th Global Privacy Assembly. “After many awards for her authority last year, this Award pays tribute to her remarkable leadership,” he said. Created in 2021 by the GPA Executive Committee in memory of Giovanni Buttarelli, former European Data Protection Supervisor, it recognises individuals who have shown exceptional leadership or promoted collaboration at regional or international level, in line with his vision for a fairer digital future for all. Congratulations👏

items.title: *** WEC Online wins a Global Privacy Assembly Award! 🏆 ***
items.description: *** WEC Online wins a Global Privacy Assembly Award! 🏆 *** We are delighted to share that the EDPS has been recognised at the 48th Global Privacy and Data Protection Awards in the Innovation category, for WEC Online. WEC Online automatically generates summary reports gathering the same information as the WEC. Reports can be viewed in the interface and downloaded locally. It is also open source: organisations can deploy WEC Online on their own infrastructure. The original WEC received the Global Privacy and Data Protection Award for innovation in 2019, so we are especially proud to be back in this category! Thank you to the Global Privacy Assembly for this recognition! Interesting? Read more! https:// lnkd.in/eR8Zg7i6

items.title: *** Data Protection Day 2027: Protecting the vulnerable ***
items.description: *** Data Protection Day 2027: Protecting the vulnerable *** Registrations for # DPD2027 are now open! On 29 January 2027, we're co-organising a one-day conference with the Council of Europe at the European Parliament in Brussels. Join us in person or online. Together with policymakers, regulators, academics, civil society and practitioners, we will assess the strengths, gaps and future direction of the EU's digital governance. 📃 On the agenda: - manipulative practices, - AI-driven discrimination, - online harms for minors, - data sharing in law enforcement and border management, and more. ✍ Find out more and register here: https:// data-protection-day.eu/
